single_donor.first_step_prediction: Each of the six actual outgoing recipient addresses has u=A and becomes(0,floor((2*A+2)/6),(2*A+2)mod6). Exactly six whole-board guarded C events occur iff that quotient is nonzero; all have class A mod3. The source becomes(A,0,2) with zero quotient.
